name: Update
evidence: returns the next screen; runs ProcessInput while inputEnabled, asks CanTransition before switching to nextScreen (+0x16c), calls UpdateInputEnabled while input is off; MenuArenaSelect calls the base then refreshes its carousel

name: Setup
evidence: overridden by 30 screens; MenuArenaSelect calls the base then loads its Lua config (digimons, arenas, menu.arena.carousel)

name: Teardown
evidence: empty in the base; MenuArenaSelect destroys all of its widgets

name: ProcessInput
evidence: loops over the 4 controllers calling HandlePlayerInput; swallows input while a reconnect dialog / system message is up (when WantsControllerCheck)

name: HandlePlayerInput
evidence: (dt, player): button presses -> OnButton(id), analog stick with 0.33 s repeat -> OnNavigate(direction)

name: OnButton
evidence: (id): MenuArenaSelect: 1 = confirm (plays "select", sets nextScreen), 2 = back (plays "cancel")

name: OnNavigate
evidence: (direction): called from HandlePlayerInput for stick directions; MenuArenaSelect moves its carousel

name: CanTransition
evidence: base returns true; Update only switches to nextScreen when it does; MenuArenaSelect waits for its panel

name: SetAnimState
evidence: (state): forwards to the menu background object; MenuArenaSelect forwards to every widget (vtable +0x58)

name: UpdateInputEnabled
evidence: base sets inputEnabled (+0x279) = 1; called by Update while input is off

name: CheckControllers
evidence: shows SysMsgReconnectController0..3 for disconnected pads; gated by WantsControllerCheck

name: WantsControllerCheck
evidence: base false, MenuArenaSelect true; gates CheckControllers and input swallowing

name: IsPrimaryControllerOnly
evidence: base false, MenuConclusionSingle true; CheckControllers then only watches the primary pad

name: Update
evidence: per frame: refreshes its scene slot, then sends overlapping objects (matching mask +0x84) a type-3 message with the volume's centre

name: HandleMessage
evidence: (msg): type 2 = contact: GetHitCharacter on the other object, then HitCharacter for object types 2-3 or HitObject for type 5; subclasses chain the base and add message 0xc handling

name: SetAttack
evidence: (damage, scale, target, active): damage/scale -> +0x1f8 (capped at 100, which sets ignoreGuard +0x1e3), active -> +0x1e0 (clears the per-player hit flags when off), target player -> +0x5b4

name: PostMessage
evidence: (msg): adds flag 0x20 and passes the message to the base

name: GetHitCharacter
evidence: (object): the character behind a contacted object if it is a live character (value at +0x244 above zero), else 0; subclasses also match their owner

name: HitObject
evidence: (object): for object type 5; uses FUN_0010dcd0 / FUN_0010e2c0 on it

name: HitCharacter
evidence: (character): skips players already hit (+0x5b8[player]), calls ApplyDamage, sends itself message 0xc with the damage, marks the player hit

name: ApplyDamage
evidence: (character): checks the hit is allowed (unless ignoreGuard), applies the target effect, then ApplyKnockback

name: ApplyKnockback
evidence: (character, source, ...): scales damage by frame time when not fixed, builds the knockback from the volume's matrix (+0x90) and hit type (+0x240), returns a float

name: GetEntityType
evidence: CreateEntityModel switches on it: 1-3 Character (CharacterModel), 4 PropObject, 5 ProjectileObject; Character forwards to its controller's GetControllerType

name: GetPlayerIndex
evidence: returns playerIndex (+0x170); CreateEntityModel uses it to pick the player's data at game+0x40+i*4

name: GetControllerType
evidence: returns 2

name: GetControllerType
evidence: returns 3

name: Update
evidence: per frame: saves velocity (+0x20) to the previous-velocity copy (+0x2c), adds frame time to the age at +0x94, re-registers in the world's spatial bucket; Character's 2.9 KB override runs movement, jumping and states

name: OnCollision
evidence: base returns 0; Character reads the contact (+0x58 other object, +0x5c point, +0xb8 normal), lands (clears jumpCount) and returns 1 or 2

name: UpdateVelocity
evidence: base subtracts gravity (+0xdc) * frame time from velocity z (+0x28); Character adds walk/run speed from its definition

name: PlayAnimation
evidence: (animId, mode) base forwards to the model's slot 27; Character also rumbles its controller for hit states 0x1d-0x1f; ResetState plays anim 1

name: UpdateFacing
evidence: turns toward the heading the model reports, clamped to the turn rate per frame

name: GetModel
evidence: returns the model at +0x18 (AnimationController / CharacterModel); its +0x188 is the current animation id

name: IsCharacter
evidence: true when GetEntityType is 2 or 3 (AI or pad controlled)

name: SetModel
evidence: (model) stores the model at +0x18 and the model's definition at +0x1c; Character then loads per-character data from the definition

name: Delete
evidence: calls the deleting destructor on itself

name: UpdateJump
evidence: per frame: reads the jump-hold action 0x1b, springboard bounce, superJump (definition) enables action 0x1c, the air-time float at +0x24c

name: ReadMoveInput
evidence: actions 0x18/0x19 give direction +1/-1 into +0x114..+0x11c; the stick amount (controller slot 3) goes to +0x228

name: CanJump
evidence: false while jumpCount (+0x174) has reached maxJumpCount (definition +0x70c) and miniJumpFactor (+0x700) is unset

name: TryDownJump
evidence: if CanJump and action 0x1a (stick down + jump button) fires, sets +0x284 and calls Character_Jump(20.0)

name: ResetState
evidence: clears velocity, state, grab and jump fields, plays animation 1

name: QueryButton
evidence: forwards to its controller's QueryButton

name: IsMoving
evidence: true when speed^2 >= 0.01 or a move/grab/stun field is set

name: QueryButton
evidence: (action, ...) answers from its own virtual button block; returns false when disabled

name: QueryAction
evidence: actions below 0x13 go to QueryButton; 0x14 and up are stick directions

name: GetStickAmount
evidence: same interface as PadController slot 3; Character::ReadMoveInput reads it through +0xe8 without checking the controller type

name: IsEnabled
evidence: returns +0x8; every query returns false when it is clear

name: SetRumbleStrength
evidence: Character calls it with 1.0 on a heavy hit

name: SetRumbleDuration
evidence: Character passes 0.75 s, or twice the frame time
